name: notation-prettifier
description: Renders rough notation (L^', n^(i), i_1^', sqrt, x as times, theta, <degrees>) as LaTeX math or symbols in the editor and reading view, and bakes the LaTeX into the note on command. Rules run offline.
author: Zoroaster1x
